name: xyst
description: Xyst shared runtime and command line agent

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @xyst/runtime && npm run build --workspace @xyst/cli
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @xyst/desktop && npm run dev --workspace @xyst/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @xyst/desktop
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && npm run package --workspace @xyst/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @xyst/runtime && npm run typecheck --workspace @xyst/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace @xyst/runtime && npm run typecheck --workspace @xyst/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @xyst/runtime && npm run test --workspace @xyst/runtime && npm run test --workspace @xyst/cli && node --test scripts/release-verification.test.cjs
